description: This file implements the StateManager9 class, which manages and caches Direct3D 9 rendering states for the ANGLE graphics library, including blend, rasterizer, depth/stencil, viewport, and scissor states.

classes.name: StateManager9
classes.description: A class that manages and caches Direct3D 9 rendering states for efficient state changes in ANGLE.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the state manager, setting workarounds based on GPU vendor.

methods.name: forceSetBlendState
methods.description: Marks blend state as dirty to force reapplication.

methods.name: forceSetRasterState
methods.description: Marks rasterizer state as dirty to force reapplication.

methods.name: forceSetDepthStencilState
methods.description: Marks depth/stencil state as dirty to force reapplication.

methods.name: forceSetScissorState
methods.description: Marks scissor state as dirty to force reapplication.

methods.name: forceSetViewportState
methods.description: Flags that viewport state needs to be forcibly updated.

methods.name: forceSetDXUniformsState
methods.description: Marks shader uniforms as dirty for update.

methods.name: updateStencilSizeIfChanged
methods.description: Updates stencil size and marks depth stencil state dirty if changed.

methods.name: syncState
methods.description: Synchronizes internal cached states with the current GL state, marking dirty bits as needed.

methods.name: setBlendDepthRasterStates
methods.description: Applies blend, depth, raster, and stencil states based on dirty bits.

methods.name: setViewportState
methods.description: Sets the viewport and updates related shader constants.

methods.name: setShaderConstants
methods.description: Uploads shader constants if marked dirty.

methods.name: setScissorState
methods.description: Updates scissor state and rectangle if marked dirty.

methods.name: setRenderTargetBounds
methods.description: Sets the render target size and marks viewport as dirty.

methods.name: setScissorEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables scissor testing.

methods.name: setScissorRect
methods.description: Sets the scissor rectangle in the device.

methods.name: setDepthFunc
methods.description: Configures depth testing and function.

methods.name: setStencilOpsFront
methods.description: Sets stencil operations for front faces.

methods.name: setStencilOpsBack
methods.description: Sets stencil operations for back faces.

methods.name: setStencilBackWriteMask
methods.description: Sets stencil back face write mask.

methods.name: setStencilFuncsBack
methods.description: Sets stencil back face functions.

methods.name: setStencilWriteMask
methods.description: Sets stencil write mask.

methods.name: setStencilFuncsFront
methods.description: Sets stencil front face functions.

methods.name: setStencilTestEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables stencil testing.

methods.name: setDepthMask
methods.description: Enables or disables depth writing.

methods.name: setSampleAlphaToCoverage
methods.description: Configures alpha-to-coverage (not implemented).

methods.name: setBlendColor
methods.description: Sets the blend color state.

methods.name: setBlendFuncsEquations
methods.description: Sets blending functions and equations.

methods.name: setBlendEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables blending.

methods.name: setDither
methods.description: Enables or disables dithering.

methods.name: setColorMask
methods.description: Sets color write mask with workaround for driver bugs.

methods.name: setSampleMask
methods.description: Sets multisample mask.

methods.name: setCullMode
methods.description: Configures face culling mode.

methods.name: setDepthBias
methods.description: Sets depth bias for polygon offset.

methods.name: updateDepthSizeIfChanged
methods.description: Updates depth buffer size and marks raster state dirty if changed.
